breadth.guidance: Above-average breadth. Normal operations with standard risk management.

uptrend.guidance: Weak breadth environment. Prioritize capital preservation over gains.

active_warnings.label: LATE CYCLE WARNING
active_warnings.description: Commodity sectors leading both cyclical and defensive groups. Historically associated with late-cycle inflation or sector rotation preceding broader market weakness.
actions: Favor lower end of exposure range (e.g. 80% if guidance is 80-100%)
New entries limited to A-grade setups only
Monitor for commodity rollover as potential broad market lead indicator

active_warnings.label: SECTOR DIVERGENCE WARNING
active_warnings.description: Significant divergence detected within sector groups. Some sectors within the same group are moving in opposite directions, suggesting hidden risk beneath the averages.
actions: Verify individual sector trends before entering positions
Avoid sectors diverging from their group majority
Monitor for group convergence or further deterioration

uptrend.warning_summary: LATE CYCLE WARNING; SECTOR DIVERGENCE WARNING
actions: Only hold strongest leaders in uptrending sectors
